entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: on()/ignoring()/group_left()/group_right() matching is not yet supported for binary arithmetic between two exponential histogram selectors; only default (full label set) matching is supported

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: internal invariant violated: exp-histogram binop operand matched no known histogram-valued shape for %v
entries.rationale: all three callers (lowerExpHistogramHistogramBinop for +/-, lowerExpHistogramHistogramCompareBinop for ==/!=, lowerExpHistogramDroppingHistogramBinop for the incompatible-type drop family) admit only isExpHistogramValuedShape operands on both sides, whose lowerExpHistogramValuedShape producer never returns matched=false for a shape that recogniser already accepted

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: internal invariant violated: exp-histogram binop operand lowering did not cap with *chplan.HistogramProjection, got %T
entries.rationale: lowerExpHistogramValuedShape's producer contract ends in *chplan.HistogramProjection for every shape it reports matched=true for — the same contract histogram_native_scalar_binop.go's lowerExpHistogramScalarBinop, and now all three of lowerExpHistogramHistogramBinop, lowerExpHistogramHistogramCompareBinop, and lowerExpHistogramDroppingHistogramBinop, already rely on
